buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses: A. Approved Vendor/OEM for the tendered items at Bhilai Steel Plant is as under: OEM - M/s SIEMENS LTD OEM is requested to submit their offer directly. b. Bidders having valid authorization of Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) can also submit offer. However, valid authorization duly mentioning GeM bid nu mber must be submitted for the instant tender along with the offer. B. In case of offer submission by authorized bidder of OEM: i) Offer submission by dealer of OEM: Supplier has to provide back-up guarante e of OEM for quality & workmanship of the ordered item at the time of supply. Submission of offer by bidders (other than OEM) construe that the above points are agreed to by them. C. Items must be supplied in OEM's Original Packing only. D. Guarantee/ Warranty Clause: The Supplier shall Guarantee/ Warranty for a period of 18 months from the date of supply or 12 months from the date of commissioning whichever is earlier and in the event of Buyer finding, within the guarantee period, that the item accept ed & supplied, is not performing as per the requirement in the Purchase Order, t he Supplier shall be liable to replace the item free of cost on FOR Bhilai basis, to the satisfaction of the Buyer. E. Vendors are requested to confirm delivery as per GEM bid or to quote their be st possible delivery period. F. It may be noted that subsequent to placement of the GeM Purchase Order (PO), a corresponding backu p SAP PO shall be issued by BSP. All post-order activities, including material receipts, Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), bill processing and any other related activities, shall be carried out against the SAP PO.

OTHER COMMERCIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS Following are other Commercial Terms and Conditions: a. Bidder has to indicate the applicable GST rate in their offer. b. Delivery Price Basis: FOR Consignee Stores, Consignee Location (all-inclusive of transportation, insurance, taxes etc. as applicable). c. Prices shall remain firm till the completion of order where PVC clause is not applicable. d. Inspection: Inspection, if required may be carried out by the Purchaser or his authorize d agent at destination, or at the Supplier’s premises or at any other place as the Purchaser may deem fit as stipulated in the Contract during different stages of manufacturing including final Pre- dispatch inspection and accordingly Inspection Certificates shall be issued. e. Payment shall be released to the Supplier / Vendor / Contractors only after verification of GST Return in the form GSTR-2A. The Supplier / Vendor / Contractors must submit their G ST Return in the GST Portal, before processing of their bills and payment by Bhilai Steel Plan t. Accordingly, all the Suppliers / Vendors / Contractors are hereby informed for compliance of submission of GST Returns in respect of various kinds of supplies of goods and / or servic es covered under a Tax Invoice. Supplier must furnish / upload the necessary documents for availing of GST Input Tax Credit (ITC) as per GST Law. f. Other relevant conditions not mentioned here shall be as per General Terms and Condi tions of Contracts for Purchase (SAIL- P1) (October 2023) which can be viewed / downloaded from https://sailtenders.co.in/ Information Standard General Terms and Conditions of Contra cts for Purchase (SAIL- P1). g. Bidders to submit filled, sealed & signed copy of following Annexures: S.NO Description Annexure No. Annexure 1 1) Acceptance of all Tender terms & conditions Annexure 2 2) FORMAT FOR UNDERTAKING . 3.
